## Appearance

Rosalind Penrose is a tiny woman with a bright, almost youthful complexion featuring rosy cheeks, sweet lips, dimples, and a charming appearance. She has lovely, thick, wavy snow-white hair that is thoughtfully set in flattering puffs and coils. Her large, gentle wood-brown eyes are filled with tiny flecks of gold.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002)_

## History

Rosalind Penrose was considered a beauty in her youth and was named by her father due to his love for the fragrance of lavender. Twenty-five years prior, her engagement to [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) ended following a prideful disagreement, leading her to withdraw from social life into the isolated [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage). After [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde stumbled upon her cottage, Rosalind welcomed them for tea and subsequently formed a close bond with Stephen's son, [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md). Later, when [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) unexpectedly returned, he sent a request through [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to visit Rosalind; upon his arrival at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage), the former lovers embraced in the garden. Rosalind and [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) were soon married in a garden ceremony before departing together by train. Following her wedding, she returned to visit [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) with [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) and attended the celebrations for Nell's upcoming wedding as Mother Rosalind.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P16](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0016), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), +30 more_

## Quotes

> “Cedric Stanhope?” Miss Rosalind’s tone shifted slightly. “What is his identity? I was under the impression that no person with that name resided in Brierley.”
>
> — Rosalind Penrose — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P81](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0081)

> "When you arrived here on that initial day, Nell, learning of Stephen’s boy startled me. Though I have been unable to bring him up to you from that moment on, I have longed to hear everything concerning him. How would you describe the boy?"
>
> — Rosalind Penrose — [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P21](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0021)

> "It makes me thoroughly embarrassed that an untested gown . . . even one made of forget-me-not organdy . . . can thrill me in this way, whereas a clean conscience plus an increased donation to Foreign Missions failed to accomplish it."
>
> — Rosalind Penrose — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P19](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0019)

> "For what I spent on them, those drapes ought to have lasted longer. Goodness, Belinda neglected to wipe down the banister once more. I am certainly going to have to address that with her."
>
> — Rosalind Penrose — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P58](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0058)

> "I observe that a problem has arisen, Nell. I will be intrusive and inquire about its nature. Have the two of you had a disagreement?"
>
> — Rosalind Penrose — [v3 ch.People P25](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0025)

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--rosalind-penrose.md)

Rosalind and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) are close friends who visit one another regularly. Their connection began when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accidentally discovered [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) while taking a wrong turn, after which Rosalind invited her inside for tea and confided in her about her solitary life and past engagement. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) subsequently helped reunite Rosalind with her former love by introducing her to his son, [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), and delivering correspondence on her behalf. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) later visited [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) during outings even while Rosalind was away, and Rosalind acts as a gentle confidante who presses [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about her romantic feelings.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P16](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0016), +18 more_

- Friend of — close friends who visit each other  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P32](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0032), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P31](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0031), [v3 ch.Again P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048), +3 more</sub>

### [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rosalind-penrose--stephen-stanhope.md)

[Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) is Rosalind's husband, following a past engagement that had ended due to a prideful misunderstanding. After years apart, [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) reached out through [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to request a visit, leading to an emotional reunion with Rosalind in her garden. The couple reconciled their love and were married at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) before departing together by train.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P20](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0020), +12 more_

### [Stanhope](../character/stanhope.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rosalind-penrose--stanhope.md)

[Stanhope](../character/stanhope.md) is Rosalind's husband. After being separated for years due to a prideful misunderstanding during their original engagement, the two reunited with the assistance of [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md). They embraced as lovers in Rosalind's garden and eventually married in a ceremony held at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage).

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P16](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0016), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019), +14 more_
